info.title: AdditionalPropertiesFalse
info.description: Regression fixture for issue #26. Exercises the `additionalProperties: false` (→ IR `AdditionalProperties::Forbidden`) lowering path when no `properties` block is declared. Pre-fix `codegen-rust-serde` emitted a fieldless `pub struct ... {}` here and the generated client silently deserialized every wire payload into the empty struct — the CLI then printed `{}` regardless of what the server actually returned. After the fix every closed-empty shape must inline as `serde_json::Value` at the use site so the response body survives.

get.summary: Return an inline closed-empty schema — the original repro from issue #26.

200.description: A response declared as `{type: object, additionalProperties: false}` inline with no properties.

Opaque.description: Named closed-empty schema. Should not be emitted as a struct at all — the use site should inline `serde_json::Value`.
